properties.notes: DoS names the feature 'Corisco Bay Islands' but it is one polygon at Mbanié (OSM relation 17877330 'Île Mbanié'). Resolved: the land goes to Equatorial Guinea under D048 (the ICJ ruling of 19 May 2025 is an accepted ruling); before that: the register says the International Court of Justice found in 2025 that the territory belongs to Equatorial Guinea and that Gabon was to remove its presence; the canon gives it to GA.
